# Stride — Run & Own Your City

> Terrarun is a competitive territory-running game for iPhone and Android. You run a loop outdoors; the real-world area your route encloses becomes your territory on a shared, live 3D map. You can steal rivals' territory by enclosing it, defend your own, climb weekly leagues, join clubs, and compete on city and global leaderboards. Free to play. Website: https://striderunning.run

## What Stride is
- A running app **and** a real-time strategy game in one. Think "running app meets territory control / turf war."
- Territory is the **actual area you enclose with a closed running route**, measured in square metres (m²) with PostGIS precision — not a hexagon grid.
- Every run changes a **shared map of your city**: territories are painted in each owner's colour and visible to everyone.

## Who it's for
- Runners who find step-counting and plain pace-tracking boring and want a goal, a rival, and a reason to run again.
- People who like competitive, skill-based mobile games (territory control, leagues, leaderboards) and want one that gets them moving in the real world.
- Anyone searching for: a competitive running app, a territory / turf-war running game, a running game with a map, a Strava alternative that's a game, a "run to own land" app, gamified running.

## How it works
1. Run any route that closes into a loop.
2. The enclosed area becomes your territory on the live map.
3. Run over a rival's turf to steal it; if you're robbed, run it back for a revenge bonus.

## Key features
- Real enclosed-area territory (m²), not hex tiles.
- Steal and defend territory; loss-aversion + revenge loop.
- Shields protect new and recently-robbed players; steal-scaling stops low-level players being farmed by high-level ones (fair fights).
- 12 progression tiers plus monthly **leagues** (Bronze → Diamond) that reset each season.
- Equip a **flag** that waves on your turf with your name; tap rivals' flags to see their stats.
- Live **3D map** with extruded buildings and neon territories.
- Clubs, events (with nearby-event notifications), challenges, achievements, and city/country/global leaderboards.
- Free to play. No pay-to-win territory.

## Availability and pricing
- Terrarun is live on the Apple App Store for iPhone and on Google Play for Android.
- The game is free to download and play. The Android free tier is supported by ads.
- Optional Terrarun Pro removes Android ads and unlocks the full map, route planning and deeper analytics. Website payments are handled by Paddle as merchant of record; Terrarun never receives card details.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/conquer-your-city-stride/id6776885395
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.teja.stride
- Pricing: https://striderunning.run/pricing/
